description: Get the converted data for a completed job: as JSON (bank, statement period, accounts, balances and transactions) or as CSV (one row per transaction). This only reads the result: it doesn't change anything in StatementPro or spend credits, and can be called again safely. For real use, pass save_to to write the full result to a file and get a short summary back. Without save_to the data is returned inline, and results over about 40,000 characters are cut off. save_to must end in .csv or .json, matching the format, and won't replace an existing file unless overwrite is true.

format.description: json or csv. Defaults to the save_to file's extension, otherwise json.

id.description: Job id from convert_document or list_conversions. The job must be completed.

overwrite.description: Replace save_to if it already exists. Defaults to false.

save_to.description: Absolute path of a .csv or .json file to write the result to. Missing folders are created.

name: get_result
title: Get conversion result
